name: Marshalls
notes: 2026-10-29: marshalls.com/ and /us/store/index.jsp return TJX's 'Something went wrong' page to WebFetch. Human check.

TJX's Marshalls page: 'acquired by TJX in 1995, joining TJ Maxx to form Marmaxx'; buyers search for 'the best finds in fashion, home, shoes, beauty, and accessories'; 'an expanded men's department' and 'a larger shoe department'; e-commerce site marshalls.com 'launched in 2019'.

2026-10-29 (TJ Maxx re-run): marshalls.com still returns TJX's error page. status=verified from TJX's official site (enrich.md §2). TJX 10-K (https://www.tjx.com/docs/default-source/investor-docs/annual-reports/tjx-2025-annual-report-and-10-k.pdf): Marshalls stores at end of fiscal 2026: 1,255 (1,230 a year earlier); both TJ Maxx and Marshalls 'sell family apparel (including footwear), accessories (including beauty and jewelry), home fashions'; Marshalls differentiated by 'a full line of footwear and a broader men's offering'; marshalls.com launched 2019. tjx.com Marshalls page: 'a larger shoe department where you'll find styles for women, men, and kids'; 'Marshalls has stores across the U.S., including Puerto Rico'.
